name: Editorial Contrast
intent: Magazine-grade hierarchy with generous negative space and one decisive accent role.
surfaceStrategy: Predominantly neutral or light surfaces with selective solid brand blocks.
contrastStrategy: High contrast between headline, evidence and metadata; never wash the full frame in the primary color.
motionSignature: Masked reveals, measured vertical lifts, sectional wipes and restrained parallax.

name: Liquid Luminous
intent: Water-led motion with depth, glow and controlled translucency without turning the piece into a blue wash.
surfaceStrategy: Layer neutral surfaces, translucent brand-role glass and localized luminous gradients.
contrastStrategy: Use light versus deep brand roles and reserve saturated cyan/primary roles for moving focal points.
motionSignature: Flow fields, liquid masks, refractive reveals, path-linked droplets and slow wave translation.

name: Documentary Collage
intent: Evidence-first visual storytelling combining real media, captions, crops and editorial annotations.
surfaceStrategy: Paper-like neutral fields, photo windows, caption bands and small brand-role accents.
contrastStrategy: Real media remains dominant; brand color organizes evidence rather than covering it.
motionSignature: Photo-stack choreography, crop shifts, contact-sheet builds, annotation strokes and slow push-ins.

name: Tactile Paper
intent: Warm handcrafted editorial system for approachable civic communication and cultural content.
surfaceStrategy: Layered paper panels, soft edges, stamps, labels and restrained texture generated procedurally.
contrastStrategy: Neutral substrate carries most of the frame while brand roles appear in labels and structural accents.
motionSignature: Paper slides, hinge reveals, clipped labels, subtle offset shadows and cutout transitions.

name: Kinetic Type
intent: Typography is the principal visual actor, supported by data and minimal geometry.
surfaceStrategy: Alternating neutral and solid brand-role fields; every scene must have a distinct typographic composition.
contrastStrategy: Scale, weight and spatial rhythm create contrast before color does.
motionSignature: Word-group masks, baseline travel, counter-motion, kinetic punctuation and timed emphasis bars.

name: Spatial Depth
intent: Cinematic layered composition using foreground, midground and background planes without pretending to be factual 3D geography.
surfaceStrategy: Depth planes, masks, soft atmospheric layers and selective photographic or illustrative inserts.
contrastStrategy: Depth and luminance separate information; brand roles remain localized.
motionSignature: Camera-like push/pull, planar parallax, occlusion reveals and tracked focal transitions.

name: Technical Grid
intent: Precise infrastructural language with schematics, measurements and network logic.
surfaceStrategy: Neutral technical canvas, modular grid, thin rules and isolated brand-role highlights.
contrastStrategy: Hierarchy comes from scale, line weight, labels and one active highlight at a time.
motionSignature: Draw-on paths, connector builds, scanning windows, callout tracking and system-state transitions.

name: Data Theater
intent: Turn verified metrics into staged visual moments rather than a dashboard screenshot.
surfaceStrategy: Large datum zones, oversized numerals, one supporting chart or annotation per beat.
contrastStrategy: Use size and temporal isolation; color signals meaning instead of decorating every number.
motionSignature: Count reveals, scale choreography, chart morphs, datum handoffs and sectional focus shifts.

name: Cinematic Masks
intent: Premium scene changes driven by shape, crop and lighting rather than card swaps.
surfaceStrategy: Full-bleed media or controlled illustration punctuated by branded matte shapes and neutral breathing frames.
contrastStrategy: Scene-to-scene contrast alternates scale, crop and surface value.
motionSignature: Iris masks, traveling mattes, split apertures, match cuts and image-to-shape transitions.

name: Modular Mosaic
intent: Flexible multi-panel storytelling that feels intentionally composed rather than template-card based.
surfaceStrategy: Asymmetric modular cells with changing proportions, occasional full-bleed interruption and controlled gutters.
contrastStrategy: Alternate dense and sparse cells; no equal-size four-card default.
motionSignature: Cell expansion, directional handoff, mosaic reflow, focused zoom and staggered evidence reveals.

name: Quiet Luxury
intent: Restrained premium communication for high-trust institutional moments.
surfaceStrategy: Large calm fields, precise typography, hairline rules, sparse imagery and deliberate silence.
contrastStrategy: Few elements, strong proportion and carefully timed accent use.
motionSignature: Slow reveal, elegant easing, subtle scale, long holds and minimal sectional motion.

name: Playful Geometry
intent: Energetic but controlled geometric motion for educational, community and friendly content.
surfaceStrategy: Neutral base with rotating geometric accents, stickers and modular shapes sourced from brand roles.
contrastStrategy: Use shape and scale variety while preserving a dominant information hierarchy.
motionSignature: Shape handoffs, orbiting accents, snap-to-grid movement and soft overshoot without spring/bounce when brand rules forbid it.
